functions.name: admin_add_xp
functions.doc:
Admin only, testnet dev cheat (scripts/dev-grow.sh): adds XP without the daily cap; the
 stage moves exactly as in normal growth (Baby 10, Teen 100, Adult 500) and emits `stage_up`.

functions.name: approve_action
functions.doc: The pet's device key only; never the key that proposed it.

functions.name: buy_item
functions.doc: Owner only; attach exactly the catalog price.

functions.name: cancel_action
functions.doc: Owner only; refunds any held deposit (also for expired actions).

functions.name: charge
functions.doc: Brain only. Never panics for lack of funds or over-cap values: everything is clamped.

functions.name: credit
functions.doc: Brain only, capped correction (credit normally accrues lazily from stake).

functions.name: empty_pantry
functions.doc: Owner only, gated by approval mode like `withdraw`: pantry NEAR back to the owner.

functions.name: feed
functions.doc: Anyone can feed any pet.

functions.name: feed_from_pantry
functions.doc:
Device key or owner wallet, no deposit: moves pantry into food. The device is capped at
 `config.device_feed_max_per_day`; the wallet is not.

functions.name: get_battle
functions.doc: A pet's battle record; level 1 and zeros before its first battle.

functions.name: hatch
functions.doc:
Owner, once: the egg hatches into a Baby on chain (Build Spec 1), so the app and the
 chain agree. Later stages still come from XP (Teen 100, Adult 500).

functions.name: nft_mint_pet
functions.doc:
Attach exactly `mint_storage + starter_food`. `mint_storage` stays in the contract to pay
 for the pet's storage; `starter_food` becomes the pet's food.

functions.doc: The pool's `withdraw` pays out principal and unstake deposit, so both go to the owner.

functions.name: propose_action
functions.doc:
Owner wallet, approval mode on. `Stake` attaches exactly `amount`, `Unstake` at least
 `config.pool_unstake_deposit`; others attach nothing.

functions.name: record_battle
functions.doc:
Brain only. Scores one finished battle for both pets; a `battle_id` seen before is a no-op,
 so the brain can retry. `loser_ran`: the loser conceded (Run) and gets no XP.

functions.name: register_device
functions.doc:
Owner only. Replaces any previous device key for this pet. In approval mode, use
 `propose_action(RegisterDevice)` so a stolen wallet key cannot swap in its own device.
 The device's function-call key (receiver = this contract) lists the methods `play`,
 `stake_from_food`, `feed_from_pantry` and `approve_action`.

functions.name: register_pool
functions.doc:
Admin, once, at deploy: a small house deposit so the pool takes its one-time
 first-deposit fee from it. After this every pet stake mints iNEAR 1:1 (S6).

functions.name: set_approval_mode
functions.doc: Owner only. Turning on needs a registered device; turning off needs a device approval.

functions.name: set_metadata
functions.doc:
Brain only, at most once a minute per pet. `media` and `reference` are `ipfs://` links,
 each hash is the sha256 of the pinned file.

functions.name: set_soul
functions.doc: Owner only, at most 1 KB. Bumps the version and updates the NFT description.

functions.name: stake
functions.doc: Owner only, at least `min_stake`. In approval mode, use `propose_action(Stake)`.

functions.name: stake_from_food
functions.doc: Device only: moves the pet's own food into its NEARON stake, within device caps.

functions.name: stock_pantry
functions.doc: Owner only, any amount. Direct even in approval mode: it adds money, like `feed`.

functions.name: sweep_credit
functions.doc:
Anyone; CREDIT can only go to `config.org_id`. The pool's `claim_deposit` is 0 today
 (`get_account`); if a pool upgrade raises it, attach it here like the unstake deposit.

functions.name: unstake
functions.doc:
Owner only; one pending unstake per pet, always treated as pending (S6). Attach
 `config.pool_unstake_deposit` (any excess is refunded); it comes back with the withdrawal.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc: Owner only, after `unlock_epoch`.
